messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: sudden surge: edge-gateway (us-east-1) 502/504 spike detected. window=4m, 502s=1,740, 504s=610, error-rate +420%. Paging diane (oncall) :rotating_light:

Diane (oncall): I'm here. Marking as active incident. Short updates every 2m.

Sam (ingress): Observed broad fanout to backend `request-router` causing connection queue growth. Retries increasing. LB retry_count metric up 3x.

Lee (sre): Querying traces: `service:edge-gateway` top spans show `upstream connect` timeouts. Running: `es-query: service:request-router AND error:timeout AND @timestamp:now-15m`

Diane (oncall): Any recent config changes? Tom (platform) - any infra churn?

Tom (platform): No scheduled releases. AWS ALB healthy check flaps around same time but 5 of 12 targets temporarily unhealthy -> flapping likely from backend overload. No DNS changes.

Nina (support): We're getting customer pings about API failures for streaming endpoints — several enterprise tenants reporting session drops. Collecting tenant IDs now.

Sam (ingress): Quick mitigation idea: enable ingress circuit-breaker for long requests and reduce max concurrent connections per upstream from 200 -> 80. Applying soft limit now.

Lee (sre): Also cutting long-tail requests: set `proxy_read_timeout` lower for streaming paths to reduce stuck connections. Patch applied to canary pool.

Diane (oncall): post the exact commands/patchs you applied for the runbook. Keep all changes reversible.

Sam (ingress): Patch snippet pasted:
```
# envoy filter: per upstream max connections
- match: 
    route: "/v1/stream"
  action: 
    max_connections: 80
    circuit_breakers: { max_pending_requests: 200, max_retries: 2 }
```

Lee (sre): I'm forcing a controlled restart on 2 request-router pods to clear stuck workers, rolling restart to avoid full outage. Restart command: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/request-router -n prod --grace-period=30`

ops-bot: action logged: rollout restart requested by lee (sre). ETA pod recycle 45s per pod.

Tom (platform): autoscaler triggered extra replicas for request-router (scale +50%). Keeping an eye on memory reclaim.

Nina (support): initial customer communication ready: "We are aware of increased 5xx errors impacting streaming and batch workloads in us-east. Our engineers are mitigating; we'll update within 15 minutes." Approve?

Diane (oncall): Approved. Post and include support contact. Tagging SEs for impacted large tenants.

Lee (sre): Observability: error count dropped ~55% after circuit-breaker + restarts. 502 rate down from 290/s -> 130/s over 6 minutes. Latency P95 for request-router still high (~1.2s).

Sam (ingress): Noting a secondary degradation: KV cache evictions on model-proxy correlated with CPU spikes; pushing a temporary shard redistribution to reduce load on overloaded nodes.

Tom (platform): Initiated shard rebalance for model-proxy cluster. Should complete in ~3m.

Diane (oncall): If errors don't continue downward after throttle release, plan B = divert 30% traffic to dedicated-hot pool. Does that require billing approval?

Tom (platform): Dedicated pool spin-up is automated for emergencies up to 200k qps; finance approval not required for emergency bursts. I'll trigger if we hit threshold.

Lee (sre): Creating a short-lived canary of fallback service: `request-router-lite` that disables heavy hooks and reduces per-request CPU. Deploying canary @ 10% traffic.

Sam (ingress): Canary in place. Routing 10% now. Initial canary error rate ~0.8x baseline.

Nina (support): Tenant list DM sent to oncall. Affected: tenant-9824, tenant-5512, tenant-11003. I'll prepare targeted messages for those with higher SLA.

Diane (oncall): Great. Keep throttles for 12 minutes, then gradually lift. Be ready to escalate to SEV if >200 tenants affected or persistent >10m.

Lee (sre): Saving traces and samples for postmortem. Noted sample trace ids: trace-0a1b2c, trace-3d4e5f.

Sam (ingress): After rebalance + canary + restarts we see sustained improvement: edge 502s now back to ~baseline over last 4m. Watching for regress.

Diane (oncall): Thanks all. I'll close active incident in 10m if stable. Please add all remediation steps to the incident doc and link runbook `runbook/gateway-5xx`.

ops-bot: Reminder: if incident remains open beyond handoff, perform proper oncall transfer.

Diane (oncall): Final note at +9m: metrics stable, customer messages posted, support triage ongoing. Locking this thread to updates only.
